superpowers.runtime-source.codex.runtimePrerequisites: Codex manifest registers ./skills and assets. Portal packaging requires a real source Git checkout, Bash, archive tools and prior official package agents/openai.yaml metadata; sync additionally requires rsync, authenticated gh, Python3 and explicit external write authority. No prior official metadata is fabricated or sync executed.

superpowers.runtime-source.cursor.runtimePrerequisites: Cursor manifest registers ./skills and hooks/hooks-cursor.json. SessionStart script requires Bash and Cursor additional_context protocol; no Cursor installation or selected-client equivalent is declared.

superpowers.runtime-source.hermes.runtimePrerequisites: Python stdlib adapter requires Hermes register_skill(Path) and pre_llm_call context-hook APIs plus original skills/using-superpowers/SKILL.md and references/hermes-tools.md. It injects first-turn context only; no post-compaction hook is available in the source.

superpowers.runtime-source.opencode.runtimePrerequisites: Node ESM adapter reads original skills; V1 uses config skills.paths and experimental.chat.messages.transform; V2 uses ctx.skill.transform and ctx.session.hook(context), skipping controller bootstrap for child sessions. Directory index form needs OpenCode 2.0.4+ per source; live compatibility unobserved.

superpowers.runtime-source.pi.runtimePrerequisites: TypeScript extension requires Pi ExtensionAPI from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and Node fs/path. It registers resources_discover and injects bootstrap on context after session_start/session_compact. Subagent/task-list tools are optional companion packages, not supplied by Pi or this release.

superpowers.runtime-source.gemini.runtimePrerequisites: Gemini extension imports GEMINI.md, which imports original using-superpowers skill and references/gemini-tools.md. Requires compatible Gemini extension/context loading; no translation to selected client mechanisms.

superpowers.runtime-source.kimi.runtimePrerequisites: Kimi manifest declares skills directory, sessionStart skill using-superpowers and native Skill/AskUserQuestion/TodoList/Agent tool mappings. Those are Kimi APIs, not demonstrated Kiro IDE/Copilot equivalents.

superpowers.runtime-source.muse.runtimePrerequisites: Muse native manifest declares all skill paths and SessionStart sh hooks/session-start; original script is Bash-dependent and branches on MUSE_PLUGIN_ROOT. Native plugin install/approval and compatible shell are prerequisites; no invocation observed.

superpowers.runtime-source.devin.runtimePrerequisites: Devin plugin metadata does not declare a tools or hook API. Upstream README requires Devin plugin install/update commands; source material alone does not establish skill activation. Execution facts beyond that remain unknown.
